name: Semantic Scholar
summary: Academic Graph API from Ai2: paper and author search, paper details, citations, references and full-text snippet search.

api_key.description: Optional Semantic Scholar API key, requested at semanticscholar.org/product/api and sent by email; sent in the x-api-key header (case-sensitive).

notes: Most endpoints work keyless, but keyless traffic shares one pool of 1,000 requests per second across all unauthenticated users, so 429s are common; a new key starts at 1 request per second on all endpoints.
Without fields, responses carry only paperId and title (or authorId and name).
Papers have two IDs: paperId (string) and corpusId (integer, used by the datasets).

endpoints.name: Search papers by relevance
endpoints.summary: Relevance-ranked papers for a plain-text query, with filters.

query.description: Plain-text query; no special syntax, and hyphenated terms match nothing (use spaces).

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return; without it only paperId and title come back. Dot for subfields, e.g. authors.name.

publicationTypes.description: Comma-separated: Review, JournalArticle, CaseReport, ClinicalTrial, Conference, Dataset, Editorial, LettersAndComments, MetaAnalysis, News, Study, Book, BookSection.

openAccessPdf.description: Present (no value) to keep only papers with a public PDF.

publicationDateOrYear.description: <start>:<end> range of YYYY-MM-DD dates; either end optional, prefixes like 2020-06 allowed.

venue.description: Comma-separated venue names or ISO4 abbreviations.

fieldsOfStudy.description: Comma-separated fields of study, e.g. Computer Science,Medicine.

notes: Returns at most 1,000 relevance-ranked results in total and 10 MB per response; use paper.search.bulk for more.

endpoints.name: Bulk search papers
endpoints.summary: Papers matching a boolean query over title and abstract, sortable, paged by token.

query.description: Matched against title and abstract; supports + (AND), | (OR), - (NOT), quotes, * prefix, parentheses, ~N.

token.description: Continuation token from the previous response.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields; nested citations/references are not available here.

sort.description: paperId, publicationDate or citationCount, as field:asc or field:desc; default paperId:asc.

publicationTypes.description: Comma-separated: Review, JournalArticle, CaseReport, ClinicalTrial, Conference, Dataset, Editorial, LettersAndComments, MetaAnalysis, News, Study, Book, BookSection.

openAccessPdf.description: Present (no value) to keep only papers with a public PDF.

publicationDateOrYear.description: <start>:<end> range of YYYY-MM-DD dates; either end optional, prefixes like 2020-06 allowed.

venue.description: Comma-separated venue names or ISO4 abbreviations.

fieldsOfStudy.description: Comma-separated fields of study, e.g. Computer Science,Medicine.

notes: Paging is by the token each response returns, not offset. Up to 10,000,000 papers can be fetched this way.

endpoints.name: Find a paper by title
endpoints.summary: The single paper whose title best matches the query, with a match score.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return; without it only paperId and title come back. Dot for subfields, e.g. authors.name.

publicationTypes.description: Comma-separated: Review, JournalArticle, CaseReport, ClinicalTrial, Conference, Dataset, Editorial, LettersAndComments, MetaAnalysis, News, Study, Book, BookSection.

openAccessPdf.description: Present (no value) to keep only papers with a public PDF.

publicationDateOrYear.description: <start>:<end> range of YYYY-MM-DD dates; either end optional, prefixes like 2020-06 allowed.

venue.description: Comma-separated venue names or ISO4 abbreviations.

fieldsOfStudy.description: Comma-separated fields of study, e.g. Computer Science,Medicine.

notes: Returns 404 'Title match not found' when nothing matches.

endpoints.name: Get paper details
endpoints.summary: One paper by S2 ID, DOI, arXiv ID, PubMed ID or URL.

paper_id.description: Paper ID: S2 sha, CorpusId:<id>, DOI:<doi>, ARXIV:<id>, PMID:<id>, URL:<url> and others.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return; without it only paperId and title come back. Dot for subfields, e.g. authors.name.

endpoints.name: Get many papers at once
endpoints.summary: Details for up to 500 paper IDs in one call.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return; without it only paperId and title come back. Dot for subfields, e.g. authors.name.

ids.description: Paper IDs, any supported form; at most 500.

notes: A read over POST. fields is a query parameter, not a body field. At most 500 IDs, 10 MB and 9,999 citations per response.

endpoints.name: List a paper's citations
endpoints.summary: Papers that cite this paper, with citation contexts on request.

paper_id.description: Paper ID: S2 sha, CorpusId:<id>, DOI:<doi>, ARXIV:<id>, PMID:<id>, URL:<url> and others.

fields.description: Fields of the citing paper plus contexts and isInfluential.

publicationDateOrYear.description: <start>:<end> range of YYYY-MM-DD dates; either end optional, prefixes like 2020-06 allowed.

paper_id.description: Paper ID: S2 sha, CorpusId:<id>, DOI:<doi>, ARXIV:<id>, PMID:<id>, URL:<url> and others.

fields.description: Fields of the cited paper plus contexts and isInfluential.

endpoints.name: Search authors by name
endpoints.summary: Authors matching a name, with optional paper lists.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields, e.g. name,affiliations,hIndex,papers; without it only authorId and name.

notes: Asking for papers fields returns every paper of every author; set a small limit.

endpoints.name: List an author's papers
endpoints.summary: Papers by an author, in batches.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return; without it only paperId and title come back. Dot for subfields, e.g. authors.name.

publicationDateOrYear.description: <start>:<end> range of YYYY-MM-DD dates; either end optional, prefixes like 2020-06 allowed.

notes: Only the most recent 10,000 citations/references per paper come back; use paper.citations for the full set.

endpoints.name: Search text snippets in papers
endpoints.summary: About-500-word passages from titles, abstracts and body text that best match a query.

fields.description: Which snippet fields to return, e.g. snippet.text,snippet.snippetKind.

paperIds.description: Comma-separated paper IDs (about 100 max) to search within.

authors.description: Comma-separated author names (fuzzy, all must match).

insertedBefore.description: Only papers indexed before this date: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY.

publicationDateOrYear.description: <start>:<end> range of YYYY-MM-DD dates; either end optional, prefixes like 2020-06 allowed.

venue.description: Comma-separated venue names or ISO4 abbreviations.

fieldsOfStudy.description: Comma-separated fields of study, e.g. Computer Science,Medicine.
